_note: THE HOUSE-STYLE WAVE (2026-08-18) — a NAVIGATION-ONLY finding-aid layer over each promotion's own verbatim data/promotions.json `house_style` string, the exact same doctrine as data/style-families.json's own per-wrestler `style` grouping (docs/PROCESS.md's Registry section): grouping is a filter convenience, never a claim about the record. A promotion's own `house_style` string is never edited, normalized, or replaced by a family name anywhere it is actually DISPLAYED (the wing placard, promotions.html's own row) — the family layer only widens what a search FACET matches. Each promotion's resolved `style_family` array (stored directly on its data/promotions.json row, since the client-side search/filter instruments read that JSON directly rather than a server-baked card) is derived by hand from the same house_style string listed here, checked against the record itself, staging-over-speech applying the same way it does to `scale`.
